title: checksum failed with xdrip, miaomiao and Freestyle Libre 2
body:
Hi,

since i have the new version of Freestyle Libre Version **2** i get the error message "checksum failed".

Samsung Galaxy S9
Android Version 8.0.0
Freestyle Libre 2 
xdrip+ Version 20190125-41e549

I tired: 
- start new sensor (more than once) 
- restart bluetooth
- restart mobile phone


What can i do? 
Is the current version of xdrip able to scan values from Freestyle Libre 2? 
Could the new version of Freestyle Libre 2 the problem? 


![screenshot_20190128-185119_xdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6576396/51855546-d4129980-232d-11e9-9345-961f889beeb3.jpg)
![screenshot_20190128-184808_xdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6576396/51855569-df65c500-232d-11e9-8683-0282bd9f7989.jpg)

comments.body: Libre 2 is currently not supported due to encryption.

thx :) i thought so.
Maybe i can fix it ;)
My wife just got a miaomiao and hers is doing the same thing. Were you able to ever get them to link up and not say checksum failed?
Libre 2 is currently not supported due to encryption.

I get a lot of checksum errors with Miaomiao and Libre (version 1).  I understand it is related to the contact between the MiaoMiao and the libre, but I am not so sure.  I get a multiple dropped signals and checksum errors in xDrip+ but none in Glimp using the same sensor / Miaomiao setup.  Is there a way to turn down xDrips sensitivity to these errors?
I'm also getting checksum error on the a new libre one sensor. Reads fine on my libre reader device. Been happy past few months and trying to wrap my head around this issue.

@filipedanunes : i started the first analysis but i have to less experience for that.
At the moment i have no further informations.
Where can I find the log files?
